DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_ThunderDragonMan:
It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. 
Fights between <characterName id=|ThunderDragonMan|/> end in the blink of an eye.

Bottles its abundant electricity into <itemName id=|Bio_Battery| style=|Status_Keyword|/> for its tamer while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_ThunderDragonMan:
While in party, 
hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> for 5 seconds.
This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack.)

Bottles its abundant electricity into <itemName id=|Bio_Battery| style=|Status_Keyword|/> for its tamer while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
